info.name: Add nodes to a Tana graph (or rename a node)

items.docs: Creates one or more nodes under `targetNodeId`, or renames the target node when `setName` is supplied. Nodes may include children, supertags, fields, and typed values (date, url, reference, boolean, file). To create a field definition set its supertag to `SYS_T02`; to create a supertag set it to `SYS_T01`; target `SCHEMA` for schema nodes or `INBOX` for the workspace inbox. Omitting `targetNodeId` places nodes in the Library.
